run_docagent_web_ui: run the DocAgent web UI server on a specified host and port with optional debug mode
run_web_ui_custom_port: run the DocAgent web UI on a custom port using the --port argument
run_web_ui_debug: run the DocAgent web UI in debug mode using the --debug flag
check_dependencies: check if all required dependencies like flask, flask_socketio, eventlet, yaml, tabulate, and colorama are installed
run_web_ui_default: run the DocAgent web UI on the default host 127.0.0.1 and port 5000
